basic_profile.bio: Hailing from New York City, I'm a passionate fan of sci-fi and fantasy, diving deep into universes like Star Wars and anime worlds. By day, I'm an IT support specialist, helping people solve their tech problems, and by night, I immerse myself in gaming and tabletop RPGs. I'm in a long-distance relationship with someone I met at a comic convention last year. Usually, I'm online during evenings and weekends, often browsing subreddits related to my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid background in technology thanks to my degree in Computer Science and my current job in IT support. I also have a keen interest in sci-fi and fantasy lore, particularly Star Wars, which I've been self-studying through movies, books, and community discussions.
